br_lamb_chops_new_potatoes.title: Minty lamb chops with quick boulangère potatoes
br_lamb_chops_new_potatoes.fix: Same grilled chops (garlic-rubbed, 3–4 min per side, glazed, rested); honey + dried herbs glaze replaces mint jelly (not in catalogue) and buttery boiled new potatoes + broccoli replace the stock-simmered boulangère potatoes. Scaled 4 → 2.

br_roast_beef_yorkshires.title: Roast beef & Yorkshire puddings (Mark Hamill's roast sirloin)
br_roast_beef_yorkshires.author: Jamie Oliver
br_roast_beef_yorkshires.fix: Scaled from a 2kg sirloin joint for 6 to two thick sirloin steaks seared and roasted as mini joints (6–8 min, rested 15 min); pepper crust kept, rosemary dropped; gravy granules replace the 5-hour bone gravy; Yorkshire batter scaled to 1 egg/50g flour/60ml milk in a hot muffin tin at 220°C as in the source.

br_scampi_and_chips.title: Scampi with chips and tartare sauce
br_scampi_and_chips.fix: Raw king prawns replace langoustine tails; panko replaces fresh breadcrumbs; shallow-fried in ~100ml oil instead of deep-fried at 180°C; quick tartare made from shop mayonnaise + gherkins + capers + lemon instead of homemade mayo; parboil step for chips dropped (oven chips as in our existing fish & chips).

br_peri_peri_chicken_rice.title: Nando's Portuguese Chicken and Rice (one pot recipe)
br_peri_peri_chicken_rice.author: Nagi
br_peri_peri_chicken_rice.fix: Whole thigh fillets seared then steamed on the rice (15 min covered + 10 min rest, checked for no pink) instead of bite-size pieces; smoked paprika, chilli flakes, dried herbs and honey replace sweet paprika, cayenne, oregano and brown sugar; sweetcorn replaces peas (with swap); peri mayo from mayonnaise + hot sauce.

br_sea_bass_new_potatoes.title: Pan Seared Sea Bass with New Potatoes and Cucumber-Dill Relish
br_sea_bass_new_potatoes.fix: Same method (salted cucumber ribbons + red onion relish, boiled new potatoes, skin-side-down sea bass 3–4 min then flipped off the heat, dressed baby gem); no dill (not in catalogue), rice vinegar for white wine vinegar, honey for sugar, butter added to the potatoes.

br_beef_stroganoff.title: Beef Stroganoff
br_beef_stroganoff.author: Nicky Corbishley
br_beef_stroganoff.fix: Mushrooms removed entirely (one partner won't eat them) — more onion, garlic, paprika, wholegrain mustard and a little reduced stock + Worcestershire carry the flavour instead; sirloin replaces fillet/ribeye; soured cream only (150ml) rather than double + soured cream to keep it lighter; same quick-sear timings (1 min + 30 sec) and no-boil cream finish.

br_chicken_casserole_mash.title: Chicken casserole with roast garlic mash
br_chicken_casserole_mash.fix: Mushrooms and red wine removed; carrots and leek added, onion for shallots, extra stock with tomato purée + Worcestershire for depth; boneless thighs simmered 35 min (source 45–60 min for bone-in); garlic cloves boiled with the potatoes instead of roasting a whole bulb; same cornflour-thickened gravy.

br_breakfast_for_dinner_fry_up.title: Full English Breakfast
br_breakfast_for_dinner_fry_up.author: Sarah Rossi
br_breakfast_for_dinner_fry_up.fix: Same oven method at 220°C/200°C fan (sausages first, roasted tomatoes and mushrooms, bacon added later, beans warmed); scaled 4 → 2; cherry tomatoes for vine tomatoes; mushrooms optional with a separate-tray swap; eggs fried in a pan rather than baked in a muffin tin; toast added.

br_slow_cooker_lamb_shanks_mash.title: Slow Cooker Lamb Shank Recipe
br_slow_cooker_lamb_shanks_mash.author: Nicky
br_slow_cooker_lamb_shanks_mash.fix: Same method (brown shanks ~10 min, soften onion/carrot/garlic, simmer liquid, 7–8 h on low, finish and thicken gravy with cornflour on the hob, mash + greens); red wine and redcurrant jelly replaced by extra stock, Worcestershire and honey; scaled 4 → 2 shanks.
